meta.description: Merge memory branch onto core branch

user.t:
Resolve an in-progress cherry-pick in the git worktree C:\Users\mariu\ruflo-wt-mergetest (detached HEAD at branch fix/core-session-paths; cherry-picking perf/mcp-memory~1 = 9c88f2b88 "perf(ruflo-core): run resolved local CLI in-process in mcp-launch", then perf/mcp-memory = d38562791). Conflicted: plugins/ruflo-core/scripts/mcp-launch.cjs and plugins/ruflo-core/scripts/mcp-launch.test.cjs.

Both intents must survive:
- fix/core-session-paths (966d8a064): resolveProjectDir() picks CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR > CLAUDE_FLOW_CWD > launcher cwd, skipping home/root/missing dirs; the CLI is searched from the project dir; the server runs in the project dir with CLAUDE_FLOW_CWD set; stderr warning when no project.
- perf/mcp-memory (9c88f2b88): when a local/global built CLI resolves, run it IN-PROCESS (set process.argv = [node, <bin>/cli.js, 'mcp', 'start'] and import() it) instead of spawning a second node; npx fallback still spawns; RUFLO_MCP_SPAWN=1 restores the spawn path.
Combined behaviour: in-process path must process.chdir(projectDir) and set process.env.CLAUDE_FLOW_CWD = projectDir BEFORE importing the CLI (only when a project dir was resolved); spawn paths (npx fallback and RUFLO_MCP_SPAWN=1) pass cwd: projectDir and env CLAUDE_FLOW_CWD as the core branch does. Keep both branches' tests, adjusted only where they conflict; add one test asserting the in-process path sees cwd === projectDir and CLAUDE_FLOW_CWD === projectDir.
Then: `cd plugins/ruflo-core/scripts && node --test mcp-launch.test.cjs` must pass fully. `git cherry-pick --continue` for the first commit (keep its message + Co-Authored-By trailer), then let the second commit (d38562791) apply (it touches only v3/@claude-flow/cli/src files; resolve if needed). Finally create a branch at the result: `git switch -c perf/mcp-memory-on-core`. Do not push. Do not touch any other worktree or anything outside this worktree. Report: final `git log --oneline fix/core-session-paths..HEAD`, the test summary lines, and a short description of how you merged the launcher logic.

handback.t:
The conflicts are resolved and both commits are applied with their original messages. Branch `perf/mcp-memory-on-core` now points at the result, and all 15 tests pass. Nothing was pushed and the working tree is clean.

`git log --oneline fix/core-session-paths..HEAD`
```
a7992f06c perf(cli): keep node:http and the security barrel off the MCP startup path
db0c10a81 perf(ruflo-core): run resolved local CLI in-process in mcp-launch
```
- **db0c10a81** keeps its original message, including the `Co-Authored-By` trailer.
- **d38562791** (now a7992f06c) applied without conflicts. It changed 3 files under `v3/@claude-flow/cli/src`.

**Tests** (`node --test mcp-launch.test.cjs` in `plugins/ruflo-core/scripts`):
```
ℹ tests 15
ℹ pass 15
ℹ fail 0
ℹ cancelled 0
ℹ skipped 0
```

**How the launcher logic was merged** (`C:\Users\mariu\ruflo-wt-mergetest\plugins\ruflo-core\scripts\mcp-launch.cjs`)
- **New `runInProcess(localBin, projectDir = null)`:** when a project directory is passed, it calls `process.chdir(projectDir)` and sets `process.env.CLAUDE_FLOW_CWD = projectDir`. Only after that does it rewrite `process.argv` to `[execPath, localBin, 'mcp', 'start']` and call `import()` on the CLI, so the CLI sees the project setup as soon as it loads.
- **`launch()`** takes the core branch's version: `{ command, args, shell, cwd, env }`, with `env: env || process.env` and `cwd` passed to `spawn`.
- **Main block, from the core branch:**
  - `projectDir` comes from `resolveProjectDir(...)`.
  - The stderr warning is printed when no project directory is found.
  - The CLI is searched for starting from `projectDir`.
- **Main block, from the perf branch:** if a local CLI resolves and `RUFLO_MCP_SPAWN !== '1'`, it calls `runInProcess(localBin, projectDir)`, with the same `.catch` and exit(1) on failure. Otherwise it calls `launch(buildLaunchSpec(localBin, process.env, projectDir))`. That covers both the npx fallback and `RUFLO_MCP_SPAWN=1`, and both pass `cwd: projectDir` and `CLAUDE_FLOW_CWD` the way the core branch did.
- **`module.exports`** is the union of both sides: `{ resolveLocalCliBin, resolveProjectDir, isNonProjectDir, buildLaunchSpec, runInProcess, MCP_ARGS }`.

**Tests** (`C:\Users\mariu\ruflo-wt-mergetest\plugins\ruflo-core\scripts\mcp-launch.test.cjs`)
- Both branches' tests are kept unchanged: the core end-to-end tests and `resolveProjectDir` test, and the perf argv test.
- The core end-to-end tests now run through the in-process path by default, and they still pass on cwd and `CLAUDE_FLOW_CWD`.
- I added one test, "runInProcess runs the CLI in the project dir with CLAUDE_FLOW_CWD set before import". A stub CLI records `process.cwd()` and `CLAUDE_FLOW_CWD` when it is imported, and the test checks both equal `projectDir`. It puts the original cwd, argv and env back afterwards.

I also launched a stub CLI by hand with `RUFLO_MCP_SPAWN=0` and with `RUFLO_MCP_SPAWN=1` and `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` set. Both runs reported cwd and `CLAUDE_FLOW_CWD` as the project directory and args as `["mcp","start"]`. No test covers the `RUFLO_MCP_SPAWN=1` end to end; this manual run is the only check of it.

One minor point: the perf branch's header comment says "Stdio, env, cwd and signals are the same process's". I left it as written. It is now slightly loose, because the in-process path changes cwd and `CLAUDE_FLOW_CWD` to match the project.
